#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n;
    cin.ignore();
    getline(cin, s);
    s = (s + "_").substr(0, n + 1);
    
    // Split by lookahead/lookbehind for '(', ')', and '_'
    vector<string> tokens;
    string current;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)s.size(); i++) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (c == '(' || c == ')' || c == '_') {
            if (!current.empty()) {
                tokens.push_back(current);
                current.clear();
            }
            tokens.push_back(string(1, c));
        } else {
            current += c;
        }
    }
    if (!current.empty()) {
        tokens.push_back(current);
    }
    
    bool inPar = false;
    int wordsInside = 0;
    int maxOutside = 0;
    int pending = 0;
    
    for (const string& token : tokens) {
        if (token.empty()) continue;
        
        if (token == "_" || token == "(" || token == ")") {
            if (pending > 0) {
                if (inPar) {
                    wordsInside++;
                } else if (pending > maxOutside) {
                    maxOutside = pending;
                }
                pending = 0;
            }
            
            if (token == "(") {
                inPar = true;
            } else if (token == ")") {
                inPar = false;
            }
        } else {
            pending += (int)token.size();
        }
    }
    
    cout << maxOutside << " " << wordsInside << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
